items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Buddy Johnson lived across the river too. Because you know of him, trombone player. Buddy Johnson. He lived across the river.

ctx.x: Big Cornish. You know the trombone player? No. No. I don't work with him. Willie Cornish? What about Frankie Deucon?

I used to play Frankie Deucon there once in a while. He played slide and trombone with Frankie Deucon. Tall, slender, dog, fall, black, cut of hair. He lived across the river. Frankie Deucon. Buddy Johnson lived across the river too. Because you know of him, trombone player. Buddy Johnson. He lived across the river. A little short for him.
Did you ever work with Buddy or Yanks or any of those guys?
